newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline pressured by supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gasoline pressured by supply.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with fuel oil steady and gasoline under pressure.
Fuel oil was broadly steady. Some length was seen in the low sulphur cracked market.
Gasoline was pressured lower by oversupply in the area and aggressive selling by a well-stocked player.
Naphtha was slightly firmer as the market took comfort from steadying Asian prices.
Gas oil traded 75 cents firmer on the screen and premiums were steady, with diesel cargoes around April +$11 cif NWE.
